import datetime,json,os,statistics,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).parent
assert not any(k.startswith(('MALLOC_','GLIBC_','LD_PRELOAD','DECIMAL_BENCH_')) for k in os.environ)
runs=[];cases=[(safe,mode) for safe in ['false','true'] for mode in ['none','mixed','sparse','all']];order=['before','after','after','before']*2
for index,variant in enumerate(order):
    shift=index%len(cases)
    for safe,mode in cases[shift:]+cases[:shift]:
        cmd=['taskset','-c','2',str(p/f'widen-bench-{variant}'),safe,mode]
        started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat()
        result=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=60)
        row=json.loads(result.stdout);assert len(row['samples_ms'])==9
        runs.append({'index':index,'variant':variant,'started_utc':started,'command':cmd,'capture':row,'median_ms':statistics.median(row['samples_ms'])})
    print(index,variant,'all widening/null-density cases passed',flush=True)
assert len(runs)==64
summary=[]
for safe,mode in cases:
    row={'safe':safe=='true','null_mode':mode}
    for variant in ['before','after']:
        times=[r['median_ms'] for r in runs if r['variant']==variant and r['capture']['safe']==row['safe'] and r['capture']['null_mode']==mode]
        assert len(times)==4
        row[variant]={'median_ms':statistics.median(times),'range_ms':[min(times),max(times)]}
    row['median_change_percent']=(row['after']['median_ms']/row['before']['median_ms']-1)*100
    summary.append(row)
(p/'widen-performance.json').write_text(json.dumps({'runs':runs,'summary':summary},indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))

import datetime,json,os,statistics,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).parent
assert not any(k.startswith(('MALLOC_','GLIBC_','LD_PRELOAD','DECIMAL_BENCH_')) for k in os.environ)
runs=[];cases=[(safe,mode,rows) for safe in ['false','true'] for mode in ['none','mixed','near_half','half','majority','sparse','all'] for rows in [64,8192,65536]];order=['before','after','after','before']*2
for index,variant in enumerate(order):
    shift=index%len(cases)
    for safe,mode,rows in cases[shift:]+cases[:shift]:
        cmd=['taskset','-c','2',str(p/f'widen-bench-{variant}'),safe,mode,str(rows)]
        started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat()
        result=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=60)
        row=json.loads(result.stdout);assert len(row['samples_ms'])==9
        runs.append({'index':index,'variant':variant,'started_utc':started,'command':cmd,'capture':row,'median_ms':statistics.median(row['samples_ms'])})
    print(index,variant,'all widening/null-density cases passed',flush=True)
assert len(runs)==336
summary=[]
for safe,mode,rows in cases:
    row={'safe':safe=='true','null_mode':mode,'rows_per_cast':rows}
    for variant in ['before','after']:
        times=[r['median_ms'] for r in runs if r['variant']==variant and r['capture']['safe']==row['safe'] and r['capture']['null_mode']==mode and r['capture']['rows_per_cast']==rows]
        assert len(times)==4
        row[variant]={'median_ms':statistics.median(times),'range_ms':[min(times),max(times)]}
    row['median_change_percent']=(row['after']['median_ms']/row['before']['median_ms']-1)*100
    summary.append(row)
(p/'widen-performance.json').write_text(json.dumps({'runs':runs,'summary':summary},indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
density_guard_iteration.finding: The density guard removed the large sparse/all-NULL regression, but 64-row mostly-null arrays still took 4-9% longer. A later experiment shared the null-skipping kernel between safety modes, but that regressed error-mode small arrays further and was rejected.

shared_fallback_iteration.finding: Sharing the fallible kernel between safety modes improved NULL-on-error small-array timings but raised the error-mode 64-row penalty to 8-17%. The final patch restores the simpler early return and the original fallback kernels.
